summary.name: SnyPy
summary.one_liner: SnyPy is an open source, self-hosted code snippet manager for creating, organizing, and sharing snippets within a development team.
use_cases: Sharing code snippets across a development team
Keeping a private internal pastebin on your own servers
Finding reusable code snippets by content or label
Controlling which snippets can be shared with a restricted group
summary.what_it_does: SnyPy lets users create, edit, and share code snippets. Users can manage their account and team labels, and snippets can be found by labels or content. Snippets can be shared with a restricted group, and the author can decide whether a snippet may be shared at all. The administrator can configure the tool globally. The page describes it as an on-premise tool and lists a demo instance and MIT license.
notable: Open source under the MIT license
Restricted group sharing with per-snippet sharing control
caveats: Page text does not describe pricing beyond the open source license
Docker is mentioned only in the awesome-selfhosted listing, not on the page itself
